(2) The scene cuts to a full-screen black background with large white Chinese characters appearing in the center. The previous game footage and the man's inset are briefly hidden from view, focusing entirely on the text overlay. (3) The original layout returns, showing intensive character combat in the game's bottom lane. The man in the hoodie reacts with wide eyes and open-mouthed expressions. Colorful UI elements and item icons are visible on the left and bottom edges of the screen. (4) The camera zooms in significantly on the man's face against a stylized dark background with radiating lines. He looks directly at the camera with a confused expression as a new line of white text appears at the bottom. (5) The view reverts to the gameplay, showing a female character attacking a crystal structure. Visual effects of blue and purple energy pulses are frequent. (6) The man occupies the entire upper half of the screen, clapping his hands repeatedly and laughing. He is framed against his indoor room background while the game footage continues below him.
